syllabus_topics: History and development of aircraft and space technology, categorization of aircraft
Basic design philosophy of aircraft construction and the role of certification specifications in its formation
Safety, reliability and airworthiness of aircraft technology
Aircraft load, load factor, flight envelope
Weights (operational, design), center of gravity position, mass envelope, diagram of payload - range
Design of basic parts of the aircraft - wing, tail surfaces
Design of basic parts of the aircraft - fuselage, power unit
Design of basic parts of the aircraft - landing gear, aircraft systems
Space environment - physical-technical context, vacuum, plasma, radiation, space debris, microgravity
Orbital mechanics - Keplerian dynamics, orbits, basic maneuvers
Thrusters and rockets reaction engines, propellants, multistage rockets
Spacecrafts - types, subsystems, payloads, specifics of manned spaceflight
Ground segment and organization - production, spaceports, communications, mission, space technology in the world and in the Czech Republic

Nyu, M.C.Y. Airframe Structural Design, 8. vydání, Hong Kong: CONMILIT PRESS LTD, 1995, ISBN 962-7128-04-X.
M. Macdonald, V.Badescu (ed.): The International Handbook of Space Technology, Springer, 2014, ISBN 978-3-642-41100-7
